tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List all available Spectrum UI components. Optionally filter by category (e.g. 'AI', 'Forms', 'Animation').

category.description: Optional category filter. Use list_categories to see valid values.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search Spectrum UI components by keyword. Returns ranked results by relevance.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 8)

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get full details and install instructions for a specific Spectrum UI component.

name.description: Component name or search term — e.g. 'animated-card', 'kanbanboard', 'event-calendar'

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all Spectrum UI component categories with component counts.

tools.name: install_component
tools.description: Install a Spectrum UI component into the user's project using the shadcn CLI. This runs `npx shadcn@latest add` with the Spectrum UI registry URL.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to current working directory.
